result.instructions: Tools for ArborNote, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which proposals are still in Draft, and what are their totals?"; "Show me the work orders scheduled for this week and their crew hours."; "Create a client for Maple Park HOA and a project at 12 Oak Lane.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ArborNote data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run arbornote_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run arbornote_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run arbornote_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. arbornote_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: arbornote_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List all clients (customers) in the ArborNote account, with name, address and contact. ArborNote API: GET /v1/clients.

tools.name: arbornote_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client by id, with its name, address, contact and client id. ArborNote API: GET /v1/clients/{id}.

tools.name: arbornote_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a new client (customer) record in ArborNote. Returns the new clientID. Adds a record; it does not change existing ones. ArborNote API: POST /v1/clients.

tools.name: arbornote_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects (job sites) with name, address, tree count and date created. ArborNote API: GET /v1/projects.

tools.name: arbornote_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project by id, with its details and the associated client. ArborNote API: GET /v1/projects/{id}.

tools.name: arbornote_list_project_tags
tools.title: List project tags
tools.description: List the tagged trees and items of one project: species, dimensions, location, health and work objectives. ArborNote API: GET /v1/projects/{id}/tags.

tools.name: arbornote_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Create a new project (job site) with its client details in ArborNote. Returns the new projectID. Adds a record. ArborNote API: POST /v1/projects.

workOrderNote.description: Note printed on the work order.

tools.name: arbornote_list_proposals
tools.title: List proposals
tools.description: List proposals (estimates) created or modified in a date range. Use startDate and endDate together. ArborNote API: GET /v1/proposals.

tools.name: arbornote_get_proposal
tools.title: Get a proposal
tools.description: Get one proposal by id: summary, status, total, account, project, client and line items, plus its approve URL. ArborNote API: GET /v1/proposals/{id}.

tools.name: arbornote_set_proposal_number
tools.title: Set a proposal job number
tools.description: Set the job number on a proposal's estimate. Replaces any earlier job number. The account behind the key must own the proposal. ArborNote API: POST /v1/proposals/{id}/number.

tools.name: arbornote_set_proposal_status
tools.title: Set a proposal status
tools.description: Set the status of a proposal, e.g. Draft, Submitted, Approved, Scheduled, Competed or Billed. This changes the proposal in the customer's ArborNote account. ArborNote API: POST /v1/proposals/{id}/status.

tools.name: arbornote_set_proposal_tax
tools.title: Set a proposal tax rate
tools.description: Set the tax rate on a proposal's estimate and recalculate the tax amount from the pre-tax subtotal. Replaces any earlier rate. ArborNote API: POST /v1/proposals/{id}/tax.

tools.name: arbornote_list_work_orders
tools.title: List work orders
tools.description: List GTC work orders with name, project, schedule, cost and progress. Without dates, completed orders show the last 7 days and all in-progress orders show. ArborNote API: GET /v1/work-orders.

tools.name: arbornote_list_phc_work_orders
tools.title: List PHC work orders
tools.description: List PHC (plant health care) work orders with treatment, price, item count and percent complete. Same date rules as the GTC list. ArborNote API: GET /v1/work-orders/phc.

tools.name: arbornote_list_crew_hours
tools.title: List crew hours
tools.description: List crew members' arrival and departure times and roles for work orders in a date range. ArborNote API: GET /v1/crew-hours.

tools.name: arbornote_list_appointments
tools.title: List estimator appointments
tools.description: List estimator appointments in a date range, with the project and the arborist assigned. ArborNote API: GET /v1/appointments.
